{{Short description|Chinese mathematician}}
'''Chen Mufa''' is a Chinese professor of [[mathematics]] at [[Beijing Normal University]]. He is a member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] and the [[The World Academy of Sciences|World Academy of Sciences]]. In addition to his work on [[probability theory]], as a mathematician, Chen contributed to [[mathematical physics]].<ref name="天津大学数学学院 2019">{{cite web | title=Chen Mufa Talks about the Understanding of Crossover Research-天津大学数学学院 | website=天津大学数学学院 | date=2019-10-31 | url=http://math.tju.edu.cn/info/1270/4767.htm | access-date=2022-12-30}}</ref><ref name="China.org.cn 2002">{{cite web | title=Mathematicians Worry About China's Math Studies | website=China.org.cn | date=2002-08-22 | url=http://www.china.org.cn/english/2002/Aug/40107.htm | access-date=2022-12-30}}</ref><ref name="Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences">{{cite web | title=Division of Mathematics and Physics---Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences | website=Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences | url=http://english.casad.cas.cn/mem/divsions/domap/ | language=zh | access-date=2022-12-30}}</ref><ref name="School of Mathematical Sciences 2011">{{cite web | title=School of Mathematical Sciences | website=School of Mathematical Sciences | date=2011-07-19 | url=http://math.english.bnu.edu.cn/facultyresearch/fulltimefaculty/35823.htm | access-date=2022-12-30}}</ref>

Chen is a faculty member at [[Beijing Normal University]] and a member of the advisory committee for the Beijing International Center for Mathematics.<ref name="北京国际数学研究中心">{{cite web | title=Advisory Committee | website=北京国际数学研究中心 | url=https://bicmr.pku.edu.cn/content/page/57.html | language=la | access-date=2022-12-30}}</ref>

He is [[Jiangsu Province]]'s first academician of [[mathematical science]].<ref name="Jiangsu Normal University 2019">{{cite web | title=JSNU celebrates the Inauguration of Academician Chen Mufa | website=Jiangsu Normal University | date=2019-10-11 | url=http://en.jsnu.edu.cn/31/ba/c13425a274874/page.htm | access-date=2022-12-30}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Chen obtained a doctorate degree in 1983 from Beijing Normal University. He joined Beijing Normal University in 1980 and became a full professor in 1985. In 2003, he was elected a member of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and in 2009, he was elected a member of the World Academy of Sciences. He is a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref name="北京师范大学数学科学学院">{{cite web | title=北京师范大学数学科学学院 | website=北京师范大学数学科学学院 | url=http://math.bnu.edu.cn/jzg/szdw/ac/212966.htm | language=zh | access-date=2022-12-30}}</ref>
